transcript: This truly is the best sugar cookie recipe and the only one that you will need to make perfectly delicious sugar cookies. No need to chill the dough, no spreading in the oven, and they taste great. Cream the butter and the sugar in a mixer. Add the eggs and the vanilla and continue mixing. I know it seems like a lot of vanilla but you need it for the moisture and the flavor. Now add the baking powder, mix until just combined. And then the flour, two cups at a time so it doesn't get too messy. The dough should completely come together and look like this when it's done. Now the fun begins. Roll out the dough with a little flour on the board, cut out the cookies, and bake soft and yummy perfectly shaped sugar cookies ready for decorating. Google two sisters sugar cookie recipe for the full recipe.
